test_title: PYST 61: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered 1 and 2. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

 All Mangoes are Kiwis

 All Kiwis are Guavas

 No Guava is an Apple

 Conclusions:

 1. All Apples are Mangoes

 2. Some Guavas are Apples
solution:
**Statements:**

 All Mangoes are Kiwis

 All Kiwis are Guavas

 No Guava is an Apple
